balls.text: that's it! all over, Tendulkar's taken his fourth catch! Raje bowls the slower ball on middle stump, Shoaib mis-hits it straight to Tendulkar at midwicket, isn't he thrilled!
the slower ball on middle and leg, Shoaib moves back and tries to defend, he manages, awkwardly
fuller length of off stump, Shoaib moves his front foot out of the way and drives powerfully through extra cover
the slower ball on off stump, Shoaib mis-times the drive back to the bowler
he gets an outside edge and collects a single towards third man
caught! The rot continues for Kolkata, Ishant drives a good length ball in the air and right back at Thornely who takes a relatively simple catch, by caught and bowled standards
good length once again on off stump, Ishant moves back and drive towards the off side
good length ball on off stump, defended on the back foot
Bravo slips in a magnificent slower ball that hits Ishant on the pads, that was going down leg side though and the batsmen run leg byes, oh he got an inside edge on to that one
shot boy! Ishant strides forward to a fuller ball and plays a pleasant-looking drive through extra cover for four, well timed that was

caught! The short of a length ball rises on Agarkar just outside off stump, he tries to cut but gets a thick outside edge to Tendulkar at first slip, he takes another easy catch and throws the ball in the air with glee etched on his face
the slower ball bowled full on the pads, flicked behind square by Agarkar
Bravo pitches on a good length and angles the ball into the right-hander, Shoaib drives off the front foot through cover
pushed off the pads towards mid-on for a single
wider outside the off stump this time, Shoaib judiciously lets it go
good length delivery outside off stump with a hint of movement away from the right-hander, Shoaib prods but gets beaten
that's very wide outside off stump, Shoaib slashes hard at it but misses, umpire Harper calls it wide

splendidly caught! That's the end of Ganguly! Thornely bowls a slower offcutter that bounces sharply from a good length, Ganguly tries to dab the ball towards third man and gets a thick edge to Takawale who is standing up to the stumps, he fumbles the catch but recovers quickly to dive in front and take it on the second attempt
nicely timed, Agarkar whips a straighter ball off his pads through midwicket
that's a high full toss outside off stump, Ganguly waits on the back foot and steers the ball towards third man for a single
good length delivery on middle and off, driven off the front foot towards the off side
Ganguly moves forward and nudges the ball off his pads towards the leg side for a single
too wide outside off stump, Ganguly sits on the back foot and cuts the ball expertly into the gap on the point boundary, Kolkata finally reach their 50 after losing a few good men along the way
what happened there? Agarkar tries to whip the ball off his hips but gets a leading edge because of the high bounce, the ball ends up at third man
good length on leg and middle stump, Ganguly moves back and punches the ball towards long on for a single
a good length ball skids through outside off stump, Ganguly tries to cut off the back foot but gets beaten
that's rather wide outside off stump, Ganguly chases but misses the cut through point, Raje's lucky to get away with that
fuller ball on off stump from Thornely, Agarkar moves forward and plays a punchy drive back to the bowler
good length on off stump at no real pace from Thornely, just 99 kmh, Ganguly waits on the back foot and runs the ball towards third man
fuller length on off stump, Ganguly moves forward and defends towards cover
a bit too straight this time, on middle stump, Agarkar moves across and nudges the ball towards mid-on for a single
defended on the off side on the front foot
too full and too wide outside off stump, Agarkar drives off the front foot towards cover
cut off the back foot through point for a single to end the over
pushed off the front foot towards cover where Jayasuriya scampers to his right and dives to save runs, how old is he again?
Agarkar moves back to a good length delivery and punches towards point
and again! this time Agarkar jumps back and flicks a ball from middle and leg through midwicket, the timing is excellent and the ball beats the fielder giving chase comfortably
too full outside off stump, Agarkar reaches out for it and drives the ball past point for four, not a bad way to get off the mark

bowled him! Raje strikes first ball! He pitches the ball on a good length and angles the ball into the right-hander, Shukla begins to play the flick but gets squared up as the ball seams away from him off the pitch, he misses and off stump goes for a walk

Ganguly's nearly decapitated Shukla! He backs away to make room and smashes a length delivery from Nehra straight at Shukla who has to duck out of the way, the ball beats mid-off and races to the boundary
pitches on middle stump and slants across Ganguly who waits on to the back foot and pushes the ball towards cover
once again Shukla gets hurried on to the back foot and defends awkwardly. Nehra's getting the ball to bounce sharply into the right-hander, Shukla gets hit on the thigh
a short of a length delivery jags back into the right-hander cramping him for room, Shukla jumps on to the back foot and defends in a hurry
short of a length on off and middle stump, Ganguly jumps across his stumps and defends towards the leg side
good length delivery outside off stump, cut off the back foot towards point
good length delivery on off stump, Shukla defends towards the off side, Bravo does what Pollock couldn't - bowls a wicket maiden

caught again! Saha flashes hard at one outside off stump, he gets undone by the bounce and seam movement away from him and nicks it straight to Tendulkar who takes a regulation catch at first slip, there's good carry on this surface and Tendulkar is standing rather deep
short of a length outside off stump, Saha stays in his crease and fishes outside off stump, he catches nothing, not even an edge
fuller ball outside off stump, Saha leans forward and drives powerfully towards cover where Jayasuriya dives like a spring-chicken towards his right and saves runs
fuller length on off stump, driven off the front foot towards cover
Bravo gets the ball to bounce and jag back into the right-hander, cutting him in half
Pollock pitches the ball around off stump and seams the ball away from the left-hander this time, Ganguly defends off the front foot but gets beaten
played down to third man for a single

caught! Pollock's done it again! He hits the perfect length around off stump, Hafeez isn't sure whether to come forward or go back, in the end he gets squared up and pushes tentatively at the ball form his crease, Pollock seams the ball away from the right-hander and hits the outside edge, Uthappa takes a simple catch at second slip
this time Ganguly pushes towards Uthappa at cover point and scurries through for the single
Pollock gets one to lift from just short of a length, Ganguly moves back and defends the ball towards point
whoa! Ganguly backs away and tries to hammer Pollock down the ground but gets comprehensively beaten
in the channel outside off stump, Hafeez lifts his bat out of the way once again, Mumbai have conceded only 27 off the Powerplay overs, magnificent effort
Hafeez lets yet another one go outside off, this time it is too wide and Bravo will have to re-bowl that
Hafeez moves forward and across and works a good length ball off his pads towards square leg, Hafeez sets off for the run but Ganguly says nothing doing, he called nice and early that time
once again Hafeez strides forward and lets a good length ball go outside off stump
we're back to a good length outside off stump, the bounce and seam movement away from the right-hander is healthy as well, Hafeez lets it go
that's a gift-wrapped boundary, Bravo pitches short and wide, Hafeez moves back and cuts fiercely through cover point for his first boundary
starts off with a good length delivery outside off, Hafeez lets the ball go through to Takawale
Hafeez moves back to a good length delivery and opens the face to steer the ball past Bravo at second slip
pitches on a good length outside off and seams away from the right-hander, Hafeez strides forward and lets it go
tight line and length around off stump, Hafeez strides forward and defends towards the off side
another good length ball pitches around off stump and seams away from the right-hander, Hafeez gets beaten

caught! Pollock's a master! He pitches on a good length outside off stump, drawing Hussey forward, he tries to drive on the up but feathers an edge through to Takawale who takes a comfortable catch, that's a huge wicket for Mumbai
there's another mix-up but no run out this time, Hussey moved forward and nudged Pollock off his pads towards midwicket, Ganguly set off for the single but got sent back
Hussey waits for the good length ball to nip back into him and sets off for the run after punching the ball towards mid-off
Nehra pitches too straight this time and strays down leg side, that's another wide
Hussey once again doesn't have any room to work with because of Nehra's movement back into the right-hander, he defends back to the bowler
Ganguly strides forward to a good length ball and opens the face to steer the ball behind point for a single
Hussey moves forward and across and flicks the ball towards square leg for a single

Nehra slants the ball across the right-hander from over the wicket and then brings the ball back into the batsman after pitching on a good length, Hussey gets cramped for room and defends on the front foot
wide outside off stump this time, Hussey lets it go and the umpire signals wide
Nehra nips the ball back into the right-hander and hits Hussey on the pad

Chopra's run out! Pollock bangs the ball in just short of a length, Ganguly jumps on to the back foot and fends the ball towards point, Chopra sets off for the single but Ganguly never wanted it, Chopra's almost at the other end by the time he turns back and Uthappa lobs the ball towards Pollock who breaks the stumps

caught! Pollock hits a perfect length around off stump and seams the ball away from Butt who leans forward and closes the face of the bat, trying to hit the ball through midwicket, he gets a thick outside edge that carries at a comfortable height to Tendulkar at first slip, the Wankhede erupts
a good length ball stops on butt who leans forward and chips it in the air but safely past Pollock, Pawar fumbles at mid-off
defended on the front foot towards the off side
that's a shocking wide from Pollock! Way down leg side, Butt tries to play the leg glance but he was far away from the ball
Butt opens the face of his bat and steers the ball towards third man
Chopra leans forward, closes the face and pushes a good length ball towards midwicket for a quick single
Nehra finishes the over well, he pitches on a good length outside off and nips the ball away from Butt who once again shoulders arms
good length delivery closer to off stump, Butt waits for the ball to shape away from him and then opens the face to run the ball towards point
Butt slashes hard at it but the ball is extremely wide outside off stump, he misses and umpire Doctrove calls it wide
Nehra angles the ball into the left-hander from over the wicket, pitches just outside off stump and then shapes the ball away from Butt who lets it go again
Butt lets a good length delivery that seams away from him outside off go through to Takawale
smashing shot! Butt moves forward to a fuller and wider ball from Nehra and lofts him expertly over cover, that's gone all the way
Nehra starts by hitting a good length outside off and seaming the ball away from Butt who gets beaten while trying to play a cover drive
once again Chopra comes forward and tries to push towards cover but gets beaten by Pollock's immaculate line and length
a good length delivery pitches around off stump and holds its line through to Takawale after Chopra gets beaten on the forward defence
dropped with soft hands towards the off side for a quick single
Butt goes after him with success! Butt moves his front foot out of the way and hits Pollock through the line back over his head for a one-bounce four, take that!
this time he stays on the back foot and pokes at the ball, Pollock slants the ball from a good length across Butt and beats the outside edge
spot on, Pollock pitches just short of a length around off stump and seams the ball across the left-hander, Butt stays on the back foot and lets the ball go

short of a length ball down leg side, Jayasuriya swivels and pulls the ball towards the fine leg boundary, what a stunning batsman, he's scored 52 out of 68 runs, whoops sorry the umpire has signaled leg byes, so Jayasuriya won't have his fifty, he remains not out on 48
it's a no ball and Jayasuriya has picked the full length off his pads and lifted it over deep midwicket for his 17th six of the IPL, he has now hit the most sixes in the IPL, free hit coming up
Jayasuriya slashes at one that bounces a bit more outside off and gets beaten
Jayasuriya stands in his crease and drives a fuller ball straight past the bowler, once he beats mid-on he stops running the single and watches the ball reach the boundary
defended off the back foot towards point
Agarkar angles the ball into Thornely, cramping him for room with the ball that nips back into the right-hander, Thornely backs away towards leg to make room and gets hit on the thigh
fuller length outside off stump, Thornely moves forward and drives towards point
good length delivery on leg and middle, Jayasuriya moves across  and pushes the ball towards square leg
Agarkar sprays the ball down leg side, that's the second wide of the over
short of a length delivery angles into Thornely who fends it on the leg side to bring up Mumbai's 50
pushed towards midwicket on the front foot for a single
he starts off with a wide ball outside off stump, Jayasuriya tries to smash it into orbit over cover but can't reach it
short of a length ball outside off stump pushes Thornely on to the back foot, he fends at it and gets beaten again
full ball outside off stump, Thornely pushes at it but gets beaten by Ishant's pace
caught! Poor shot from Uthappa, he moves forward and tries to pull a short ball from outside off stump, he ends up hitting it tamely towards Ganguly at mid-off
a bit too full and a bit too straight, Uthappa gets into the boundary act and leans across his stumps to flick the ball firmly through midwicket for four
short of a length outside off stump, Uthappa flashes and gets beaten
good length delivery on off stump, defended on the front foot towards the bowler

incredible incredible shot! Shoaib goes back over the wicket and bowls a short of a length delivery on leg and middle, Jayasuriya moves across his stumps and plays a short arm pull that sends the ball soaring over deep midwicket
too full and too wide outside off stump, Jayasuriya leans into it and powers the ball over extra cover with a full and free swing of his bat, the ball bounces once before going over the boundary
Shoaib pitches short and Jayasuriya pulls the ball along the ground through midwicket

shot! Stunning stuff! Jayasuriya moves a fraction across his stumps and picks Shoaib off his pads and deposits him over the long leg boundary, that was hit hard and flat with a lot of bottom hand and it just cleared the boundary

Shoaib gives Jayasuriya a tiny bit of room outside off and that's all he needs to uses his forearms and drives the ball hard through cover off the back foot, he's not timed it well but the ball still goes over the boundary
Shoaib fires the ball in from wide of the crease, Uthappa jumps back and across and fends the ball towards the leg side, he calls Jayasuriya through for the quick single
Jayasuriya moves on to the front foot and closes the face of the bat to play the ball towards midwicket

horrid fielding from Agarkar, Ishant bowls a full ball angling into the left-hander from round the wicket, Jayasuriya moves forward to drive but gets a thick outside edge towards third man where Agarkar runs towards his left to field but muffs it
Ishant jags the ball back into the right-hander and Uthappa moves across his stumps and glances the ball off his pads towards fine leg
shot! the length is too full outside off stump, Uthappa strides forward and drives the ball sweetly through the gap and cover point to get off the mark
there's just a bit of width outside off and Jayasuriya uses his powerful forearms to cut the ball towards third man off the back foot, the fielder was pushed back by the momentum of the ball
short ball down leg side, that's a wide from Ishant
that just cleared the in-field! Ishant bowls a good length ball on leg and middle, Jayasuriya moves forward and across and chips the ball unconvincingly in the air over Ganguly at mid-on
Shoaib gives him a short ball outside off to start with, Uthappa lets it go

gone! Shoaib's stunned the crowd by dismissing Tendulkar for a duck! The ball pitches on a good length around off stump and seams away from the right-hander, Tendulkar moves back and swishes away from his body, he gets a thick edge through to Saha who takes a simple catch
short of a length angling into off stump, Tendulkar moves back and opens the face to play the ball towards point
awesome ball, Shoaib angles the ball in at pace to Tendulkar , pitches around off stump and seams away from the right-hander, Tendulkar gets squared up while trying to defend and gets beaten
Jayasuriya uses the width outside off to cut towards third man
Shoaib strays down leg side this time and the umpire signals wide

dropped!! Shoaib bangs the ball in short outside leg stump, the ball gets big on Jayasuriya who tries to pull, he gets hit on the glove and the ball lobs up towards first slip where Chopra gets a hand to it but can't hold on
